description: This file defines the EmailService interface in the package com.karankumar.bookproject.book.service. It declares methods for sending emails, including a simple message and a template-based message with Thymeleaf, and a default method to extract the username from an email address.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: An interface for email-related operations, including sending messages and formatting email addresses.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Sends a basic email message given sender, recipient, and message content.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Sends an email using a Thymeleaf template, with recipient, subject, and template model, potentially throwing MessagingException.

methods.name: getUsernameFromEmail
methods.description: A default method that extracts and returns the username part of an email address (substring before '@').
